name: A. S. Palmer
description: Documented New Zealand GIS and spatial-information contribution, 1993.
story: A. S. Palmer was a co-author, with C. S. N. Priyono and M. P. Tuohy, of a 1993 New Zealand Soil News abstract on GIS-supported soil conservation planning. Their documented case examined a farm in the Āpiti district and the use of GIS to present information for land management decisions.
The source identifies Palmer as a contributor to this study. It does not specify an individual technical role or establish a wider GIS employment history, so the entry retains the published initials.
